lead: Experience heading the Design & Technology department at the Skolkovo International Gymnasium: curricula in AI, programming and robotics, an engineering lab and dozens of student projects — from robots to neural networks.

umnik.title: Grant project: a platform for learning machine vision
umnik.text: A mobile platform on a steerable chassis with neural networks for traffic sign recognition, a test track with 3D visualisation, and teaching materials for school students.

intel.title: 1st place — Intel AI for Youth national contest
intel.text: Teaching case “Machine vision with a 3D camera for a self-driving car on Raspberry Pi”.

pedcom.title: 1st place — PedKom national contest
pedcom.text: “Innovative technologies in education”: a computer science lesson with augmented reality.

trainer.title: Intel AI for Youth master trainer
trainer.text: Certified master trainer of the programme and teacher at Yandex Academy Lyceum.

hackathon.title: StarLine “Smart Car” hackathon
hackathon.text: 4th place with a team of teachers at the Robofinist international festival.

intelStudents.title: Intel AI for Youth national project contest
intelStudents.text: Project “Eye”: computer vision tracks how people move around a building.

firstRussia.title: First Russia Robotics Competition, Moscow
firstRussia.text: “Smart home” project in FIRST LEGO League Junior.

prizma.title: PRIZMA international contest
prizma.text: A glove for blind and visually impaired people.

shustrik.title: SHUSTRIK national contest, “Space” category
shustrik.text: Research complex: an Arduino rover and a station controlled from an Android app.

expert: Judge and expert at robotics competitions and project contests: Robofest, RRO, SK Junior Challenge national olympiad.
